references.text: The preceding verse describes the wise women who spun with their hands - linen, purple and scarlet. Verse 26 continues by describing a special group of women who spun goat hair.
Describes those who have the spirit of wisdom (חָכְמָה), the same Hebrew word used to describe the women's skill in spinning.
God gave wisdom in the heart to all who were wise at heart, the same concept of God-given wisdom for craftsmanship.
Refers to those whom God gave wisdom and understanding in their hearts to carry out the work on the sanctuary.
Describes curtains of goat hair that were to be made for the tabernacle - the material that the women in 35:26 spun.
The skilled woman who places her hands on the distaff and holds the spinning wheel, an example of women's wisdom in craftsmanship.
